title: Brand band: an AI-lab corporate site's grammar - ivory, oat and near-black bands, an editorial serif for statements against a grotesque for titles, square colour fields carrying one hand-drawn marker picture
summary: An ivory page that runs into an oat band and a near-black band; an editorial serif (weight 400) for statements and ledes, a bold grotesque for titles and a regular one for labels; 16 unit cards on paper, 10 unit ink buttons, full-radius nav pills with a hairline; square flat colour fields (sage, blush, lilac, sky, sand) that each carry one small hand-drawn picture: a black marker ribbon of varying width with a few flat misregistered fills, eight original subjects drawn in code (hand and node graph, seedling, open book, magnifier over a waveform, two hands passing a spark, mountain path, candles growing leaves, compass); one clay accent used for small marks only.

provenance.case: product-site kit: an original one-page site in Chinese for the owner's own quant system (research, backtesting, live monitoring; sample copy, no customers, quotes or metrics) in examples/brand-band-site-kit, and six parametric parts of it as templates, with the eight-subject illustration kit drawn in code.
provenance.lineage: AI-lab corporate site: cream-to-black band rhythm, editorial serif, hand-drawn organic illustrations on colour fields. Public pages the owner named (a home page, a news article page and a careers page), captured and measured privately in Chrome (computed styles, 2026-11-21); the captures stay private and are not shipped. Borrowed: the grammar and the measured numbers. Never borrowed: any name, logo, wordmark, picture, copy or the original proprietary typefaces; every illustration is our own drawing.
provenance.borrow: Borrow grammar, never assets. Every word is our own placeholder; the faces are open (Newsreader, Hanken Grotesk, Noto Serif SC, Noto Sans SC), named and never bundled; the pictures are generated by illustrations-band.cjs (marker ribbons from hand-placed points, deterministic).
provenance.rounds: One measured round on three pages (a model page behind a redirect to another domain was not permitted to the browser and was left out; a model announcement page on the same site gave the black hero and the article grammar instead), then the six templates and the kit built on the numbers; the pictures were redrawn until the hands, leaves and nodes read as deliberate drawings; template check --browser 0 findings on every default render.
measured: Ground #FAF9F5, ink #141413, body on cards #3D3D3A, secondary #5E5D59, small light text on black #B0AEA5; paper card #F5F4ED, oat band #F0EEE6, light grey #E8E6DC, grey #DEDCD1; black hero #0D0C0B, footer #141413 (628 tall).
Colour fields behind the pictures (public palette tokens): sage #BCD1CA, blush #EBCECE, lilac #CBCADB, sky #6A9BCC, sand #E3DACC; flat accents olive #788C5D and clay #D97757.

Type: statement serif 47.8 / 59.7 weight 400 with -1% tracking on the home page; section serif 32 / 38.4; lede serif 28 / 36 (article) and 22 / 31.9 (careers); body serif 17 / 26 in a 720 column; titles bold grotesque 22 / 27.5 (cards), 35.9 / 40.9 (article H1, centred) and 60.7 / 65.6 (careers H1); labels grotesque 13-15; tag 13 px bold with .13 px tracking.

Layout: 84 px sticky nav on the ivory ground, pills left, wordmark centred, pills right; content inset 80 px; three cards 571 x 426, radius 16, padding 32, gap 24; the oat band inset with 64 px vertical padding and square corners, a heading left, a square colour field 466 and a title with a 15 / 22.5 body to its right with a counter and two arrow buttons; footer black with 13 px links; article images radius 4.

Controls: nav pills radius full, 13 px, padding 8 x 16, 28 high, fill #F5F4ED, hairline #E8E6DC, text #3D3D3A (on black: fill #262624, hairline #3D3D3A, text #FAF9F5); primary button #141413 with ivory text, 17 px, padding 12 x 24, radius 10, 36 high; secondary a flat #E8E6DC with an arrow.

Pictures: a flat colour field (466 square on a 1745 band), one small picture about a third of the field, black marker line about 1% of the field wide with round ends and a variable width, objects as flat ivory shapes without an outline, hands as a few parallel finger strokes; an accent fill sometimes (sky, clay) offset a few units from its line.
Motion: items fade in on scroll (opacity .25-.3 s), colour .2 s ease-out, background .2 s ease, transform .15 s ease-out on 39 hover rules, a carousel of pictures with arrows and a counter.
64 px: with the wordmark masked, ivory bands, a serif statement and a flat colour square with a small black drawing read as the grammar and apart from the other packs.

ivory.use: the page ground, picture paper fills, the primary button's text on night

stone.use: nav pill hairlines, rules on ivory

ink.use: titles, statements, the primary button, picture strokes

body.use: decks, card text, nav pill text (10.6:1 on ivory)

mute.use: dates, bylines, captions, meta (6.3:1 on ivory, 5.7:1 on oat)

dim.use: light small text on the near-black band (8.4:1)

coal.use: hairlines and the ghost button on the near-black band

sage.use: a colour field behind a picture

blush.use: a colour field behind a picture

lilac.use: a colour field behind a picture

sky.use: a colour field, or a flat accent inside a picture

olive.use: a flat accent inside a picture (leaves, hills, candles)

serif.use: statements, headlines, ledes and decks: a warm editorial serif, weight 400; Noto Serif SC carries CJK

sans.use: titles (bold 700), nav pills, buttons, labels, dates, body on cards; Noto Sans SC carries CJK

fonts.resolve: fonts query --style mincho (Noto Serif SC) and --style gothic (Noto Sans SC) cover CJK copy; Newsreader and Hanken Grotesk are Latin faces, so a CJK string falls through to the stack's last family inside one role, the same family for the whole role.
fonts.licence: All roles use SIL OFL 1.1 fonts. The original sites' own proprietary typefaces are not used and not named.
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. --font-dir <dir> reads coverage and embeds the faces.

grammar: Bands: ivory #FAF9F5 into oat #F0EEE6 into near-black #0D0C0B and back to ivory; a band is a full-width ground with 64-80 units of vertical padding, never a gradient, never a shadow.
Serif for statements, headlines and ledes at weight 400 (a bold grotesque for titles on cards and articles, a regular grotesque for labels, buttons and card text): two voices, never three.

Nav: pills left, a bold tracked wordmark centred, a pill right; pills are full radius with a paper fill and a 1 unit hairline; buttons are 10 unit radius: ink with ivory text, or a flat grey; on the black band the primary flips to ivory.
Cards: paper #F5F4ED, radius 16, padding 32, a square colour field at the top with one picture, a bold title, one or two sentences and an arrow link; three across with a 24 gap.

Pictures: one subject on a flat square field (sage, blush, lilac, sky or sand), about 80% of the field at the most and mostly empty; a black marker line of varying width, objects flat ivory without an outline, one or two flat accents (olive, sky, clay) offset a few units from their lines.
The black band carries one big serif statement in ivory, a label above it in small bold tracked grotesque, an ivory primary button and a grey ghost one, and a hairline footer row.
An article cover is a full-height square field with its picture beside a column: category and date, a bold title, a serif deck and a byline above a hairline.
A social card is half ivory with a serif headline and half a colour field with its picture; a CTA row sits on an oat band, centred.

procedural: marker ribbons: a stroke is a filled polygon around a Catmull-Rom centre line whose width swells in the middle and tapers to blunt rounded ends, with a low-frequency wobble; closed shapes overshoot their start and miss it by a hair (illustrations-band.cjs)
a crayon line filter over every stroke of a picture (a fine turbulence displacement and a paper-tooth alpha mask, units of the picture's own 400-unit box so the grain scales with the tile)
flat misregistered fills: ivory, olive, sky or clay shapes nudged 3-7 units from their lines like an off-register print; no texture on a fill
eight original subjects: hand-graph, seedling, book, magnifier, spark-hands, path, candles, compass
recipes: A paper grain for a whole page: materials generate --generator paper --seed 1, laid at 20-30% over an ivory band (the templates stay flat).
collage: No photographs: pictures are drawn. Text never sits on a colour field or a picture; it sits on a band or a card.
materials.sources: Everything is drawn or generated in code.

grammar: Pictures draw themselves: each stroke of a picture reveals along its centre line (a mask path with a dashoffset from 1 to 0, 0.9 s ease-out, 70 ms between strokes) when the tile scrolls to 35% in view; the flat fills fade in after the lines.

Cards and rows fade up 12 px and in over .45 s as they enter, one after another by 80 ms; the band transitions are plain cuts at the band edge (ivory to oat to near-black), with the nav pills switching to their dark colours over a black band.
Hover: a card lifts 4 px over .15 s ease-out and its field zooms the picture 1.03; buttons change colour over .2 s; links keep a 1 px underline offset 3.
prefers-reduced-motion removes every one of these: the page loads in its final state.
motion.flashLimit: No flashing: nothing loops; everything runs once as it enters.

guidance: 64 px distinctiveness (guidance): shrink the render to 64 px tall with the wordmark masked; the bands, the serif statement or the flat colour square with a small black drawing should still read. A grey-led or photo-led page reads as another pack.

The pictures are the signature: keep one subject per field, small in a mostly empty square, with a flat accent or two and never a second drawing style (no outlines on objects, no gradients, no clip art): redraw a picture that reads as an icon.
Clay is 2.96:1 on ivory: small marks only (a flag, a spark, a dot), never running text. Small text on the near-black band uses #B0AEA5 or the ivory, never a mid grey.
Latin serif and sans faces have no CJK: keep each string in one role and let the stack's last family carry the CJK; do not mix a CJK clause into a tracked all-caps label.
The field behind a picture is never the picture's own accent: the layouts switch olive to clay on an olive field and sky to clay on a sky field.
checks.note: The browser check runs on every render. Pictures and filters are decoration: the static check reads the fields as plain rects and measures the text slots.

examples.note: The kit page is the example: one self-contained product site with every device above.

renders.screen: a product landing page in Chinese (1440 and 390 wide)
renders.why: a scrolling page with the nav, a serif hero with a picture on a field, an oat band of three cards with pictures, a near-black band with a statement, an ivory closing band and a black footer; its parts are the six templates; strokes draw in on scroll and motion settles under prefers-reduced-motion
